CODE: nightmare


🃏 Run your own trading card shop on a cozy town plaza, rip open booster packs and chase the rarest cards in the set!

📦 RUN YOUR SHOP
- Order stock, haul in deliveries and fill your shelves
- Set your own prices (customers walk away from rip-offs)
- Ring up sales and count out change at the till
- Hire stockers and cashiers, add self checkouts
- Expand your shop floor, stock room and tournament hall

✨ COLLECT
- Open 4 kinds of booster packs
- Chase a 236-card Base Set with shinies and secret cards
- Fill your binder and sell singles from display tables

⚔️ DUEL
- Battle opponents at your shop's play table

🎨 MAKE IT YOURS
- Name your shop, paint it and decorate with 120+ items
- 8 shops per server, so you can visit your neighbors
- Day and night cycle, and new unlocks almost every level
